newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Experience expects to post year profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ Experience expects to post year profit.

text.p: Tourist operator The New Zealand Experience Ltd on Friday said it was trading ahead of its budgets for the September quarter and expected to report a profit for the full year.

The company said its Rainbow's End funpark in Auckland, while not quite achieving its visitor or earnings budgets for the year, was enjoying strong growth in visitor numbers and providing significant cash flows for the group.
"We expect 300,000 visitors in the new financial year," NZ Experience said at its annual meeting.
"The operation is improving its profitability and is expected to show growth in profit."
The Christchurch Gondola was ahead of budget for the September quarter and despite a budgeted reduction in visitor numbers was likely to provide positive cash flows this year.

"We believe the company is on the road to recovery...(it) has had a good first quarter start to the year. We know of no reason why this should not continue for the remainder of the year and therefore...expect to report a profit for the year in progress."
